name: comparison/speedup-fixed
description: Fixed chunks at every p and graph: static blocks; dynamic 64; guided 64; edge-balanced. Serial is p=1. Speedup shading preserves the original bootstrap intervals. Independent jobs/nodes and SMT modes differ; cross-graph differences are not controlled hardware comparisons.

name: comparison/efficiency-fixed
description: Fixed chunks at every p and graph: static blocks; dynamic 64; guided 64; edge-balanced. Serial is p=1. Speedup shading preserves the original bootstrap intervals. Independent jobs/nodes and SMT modes differ; cross-graph differences are not controlled hardware comparisons.

name: comparison/runtime-strategies-16
description: Fixed chunks at every p and graph: static blocks; dynamic 64; guided 64; edge-balanced. Serial is p=1. Observed min–max ranges. Independent jobs/nodes and SMT modes differ; cross-graph differences are not controlled hardware comparisons.

name: comparison/chunk-sensitivity-16
description: All chunks 0/16/64/256 at p=16; categorical x positions. No per-point tuning.

name: comparison/profile-edge_imbalance
description: Only skewed/hub were profiled. Instrumented times are not mixed with primary timing runs. Fixed chunks at every p and graph: static blocks; dynamic 64; guided 64; edge-balanced. Serial is p=1.

name: comparison/profile-update_time_imbalance
description: Only skewed/hub were profiled. Instrumented times are not mixed with primary timing runs. Fixed chunks at every p and graph: static blocks; dynamic 64; guided 64; edge-balanced. Serial is p=1.

name: comparison/locality-runtime
description: Both graphs use the same node/job, executable and parameters. No cache counters were collected.

name: comparison/locality-runtime-ratio
description: Ratio = permuted median / local median; min/max bounds are not confidence intervals. No claim of cache-miss causality.

name: comparison/best-speedup-16
description: Post-hoc maximum paired speedup at p=16; runtime ranking may differ because paired speedup is not a ratio of medians.

name: comparison/best-efficiency-16
description: Post-hoc maximum paired speedup at p=16; runtime ranking may differ because paired speedup is not a ratio of medians.

name: comparison/graph-structure
description: Raw structural statistics; no unmeasured degree distribution is inferred.

name: comparison/kernel-vs-total-16
description: Independent medians of kernel and total solve time; total includes setup, but excludes graph IO.

name: comparison/runtime-variability-16
description: Variability of every p=16 parallel configuration, without filtering high-variance samples.

name: comparison/profile-worker-work-16
description: Block 0, p=16, fixed chunks. Ratios normalize raw counters by the team mean; no representative run was cherry-picked.
